Install using your TV browser

Download the official APK directly if your TV browser supports downloads.

Requires Android TV or Google TV on Android 8.0 or newer, with APK installation allowed.

  1. Open the release link on the TV. Use a browser that can download files. SweepMyTV preview release
  2. Download the signed APK. Open Assets and choose sweep-tv.apk. You can also use the release’s direct APK URL below.
  3. Open the downloaded file. Go to Downloads in the browser or in a TV file manager. Allow installation from the app opening the file if requested. Select Install, then open Sweep TV from Apps.
https://github.com/akhiltaneja/SweepMyTv/releases/download/v1.3.0-sweep.151/sweep-tv.apk
If the browser cannot save an APK

On devices that offer it, use Downloader by AFTVnews. Phone or USB transfer also works on TVs that permit sideloading.
